title: EEG: Three-Stim Auditory Oddball and Rest in Acute and Chronic TBI
description: This dataset comprises three-stimulus auditory oddball task and resting-state EEG recordings collected from control subjects, individuals with sub-acute mild traumatic brain injury (mTBI), and chronic TBI patients. Longitudinal data were acquired at multiple timepoints (3-14 days, ~2 months, and ~4 months post-injury for acute/sub-acute groups), with resting-state recordings also included. The dataset supports investigation of event-related potentials and neural oscillations associated with auditory attention and cognitive processing across the TBI recovery trajectory.
methods_description: Three-stimulus auditory oddball task and resting-state EEG recordings were collected from 2016-2018 at the Center for Brain Recovery and Repair at the UNM Health Sciences Center. For control and sub-acute mTBI groups, Session 1 occurred 3-14 days post-injury (with concurrent MRI), Session 2 at approximately 2 months (1.5-3 months), and Session 3 at approximately 4 months (3-5 months) following Session 1. Chronic TBI participants completed a single session. Task parameters and analysis scripts are provided in Matlab format.
